Headline: "AI observability for modern applications"
Desc: "Build, run, and optimize AI-powered applications confidently with full-stack
observability, performance insights, and cost control across your AI stack."
Tagline: "Observability makes AI your business partner"

Observes: response time + quality metrics; token tracking (request tokens used); APM golden
signals; infrastructure monitoring; AI metrics summaries; model response consolidation;
outlier identification; trace visibility prompt->response incl. user feedback; issue detection
(bias, hallucination, toxicity); cost monitoring + custom alerts; model comparison (cost /
performance / quality); prompt + response analysis; multi-agent mapping + interaction viz;
tool call tracking by AI agents; distributed tracing w/ granular agent/tool visibility;
latency + error identification; MCP server call monitoring across full request lifecycle;
model prediction tracking + drift detection; performance dashboards; alert management +
applied intelligence.

Integrations named: OpenAI (models); Pinecone (vector DB); LangChain (framework);
Model Context Protocol (MCP). Adjacent: New Relic Security RX, New Relic alerts.
